# Song import fixtures

Fixtures for the song-import v2 contract and the Markdown song parser (T2.10). `contract/` holds the payload corpus in the seven categories of the T0.8 corpus (`minimal.valid`, `representative.valid`, `boundary.valid`, `invalid.reject`, `unknown-version.reject` (a v1 payload), `missing-reference.reject`, `tampered-hash.reject`) plus `duplicate-id.reject` and `null-member.reject`; each `.reject` has a `.expect` file naming the finding code (the JSON Schema alone cannot see a duplicate id, only the Rust validator can). `batch/` holds the five documents the import E2E classifies (`01-new-song`, `02-unchanged`, `03-attachable`, `04-ambiguous-replacement`, `05-invalid-tampered-hash`) and `seed.json`, the Library they are classified against (Choirs, Songs and Arrangements with sections as lyrics and the Sequence as section indexes). `markdown/` holds eight Markdown songs (full front matter, forward and backward repeats, `[Unlabeled]` and text outside labels, an unresolved repeat, an ambiguous repeat, CRLF with a BOM, a missing title, bad front matter), each with a `.expect.json` sibling that the domain parser tests compare against (checked out byte for byte; see `.gitattributes`).
